candidates.title: Roth IRA: What is a Roth IRA? | Charles Schwab
candidates.snippet: A Roth IRA is a retirement account that lets you invest money you've already paid taxes on. While you don't get a tax break the year you contribute, once invested, your money grows tax-free. After age 59½, you can withdraw your funds without taxes or penalties, as long as the account has been open for at least five years.
